review_candidates.title: Sr Systems Engineer - AWS Cloud & Linux
review_candidates.description_excerpt: This role builds and manages cloud infrastructure through automation and infrastructure as code, administers and hardens the Linux fleet, and is a primary technical contributor to the availability and security of DMSi’s hosted environments. Responsibilities And Duties Build, manage, and scale AWS cloud environments supporting DMSi products including Frameworks, ACC, and our data platform. Administer, patch, and harden Linux servers across the fleet, including planning and executing OS version up
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities Deep, hands-on proficiency with core AWS services (EC2, VPC, IAM, S3, ELB, and related services), sufficient to design and build production environments independently. Proficiency with infrastructure as code, using Terraform for infrastructure and Ansible for OS-level configuration. 5+ years of experience administering Linux systems in a production environment. 3+ years of hands-on experience building and managing AWS infrastructure.
